"""Run the original Lanchester workflow from the command line."""

from pathlib import Path

import torch

from .model import build_model
from .plots import save_matrix_views, save_populations, save_vectors
from .quantum import sampled_swap
from .workflow import show_result, solve

OUTPUT = Path("artifacts/development/lanchester-hhl")


def main() -> None:
    """Regenerate both systems, execute quantum circuits and save comparisons."""
    model = build_model()
    original = torch.linalg.solve(model.operator, model.forcing)
    print(
        save_matrix_views(
            (
                ("Original operator", model.operator),
                ("Forcing vector", model.forcing[:, None]),
            ),
            OUTPUT / "original-system.png",
        )
    )
    print(
        save_vectors((("Direct classical", original),), OUTPUT / "classical-vector.png")
    )
    print(save_populations(original, OUTPUT / "classical-populations.png"))
    print(
        save_matrix_views(
            (
                ("Hermitian embedding", model.hermitian),
                ("Normalized padded vector", model.padded[:, None]),
            ),
            OUTPUT / "hermitian-system.png",
        )
    )
    print(
        save_matrix_views(
            (("Shifted and rescaled operator", model.rescaled),),
            OUTPUT / "shifted-system.png",
        )
    )
    solution = solve(model)
    swap = sampled_swap(solution.logical, solution.reference)
    show_result(solution, swap)
    print(
        save_vectors(
            (
                ("Direct classical", solution.reference),
                ("Native HHL", solution.statevector),
            ),
            OUTPUT / "hhl-vector.png",
        )
    )
    print(
        save_populations(
            original,
            OUTPUT / "hhl-populations.png",
            solution.statevector * model.forcing.norm(),
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Compare the source finite-width HHL and SWAP test with a direct solve."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

from flagquantum import synth
from flagquantum.compiler import ResourceEstimate

from .model import COMPLEX, Model
from .quantum import SwapReadout, build_native, logical_state


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Solution:
    """Actual coherent readout of all 32 words and the eight population steps."""

    program: synth.Program
    resources: ResourceEstimate
    logical: torch.Tensor
    statevector: torch.Tensor
    reference: torch.Tensor
    fidelity: float
    probability: float


def solve(model: Model) -> Solution:
    """Run native HHL and read the indicator-one, phase-zero branch."""
    program = build_native(model.evolution, model.angles, model.padded)
    logical = logical_state(program)
    branch = logical[1, :, 0]
    unnormalized = branch / model.cutoff
    reference = torch.linalg.solve(model.hermitian, model.padded).to(COMPLEX)
    fidelity = float(
        torch.vdot(reference / reference.norm(), branch / branch.norm()).abs().square()
    )
    resources = program.report["resources"]
    if not isinstance(resources, ResourceEstimate):
        raise TypeError("Expected the native HHL resource estimate")
    return Solution(
        program,
        resources,
        logical,
        unnormalized,
        reference,
        fidelity,
        float(branch.abs().square().sum()),
    )


def show_result(solution: Solution, swap: SwapReadout) -> None:
    """Report both readouts with their distinct postselection conditions."""
    print("Native HHL physical resources:", solution.resources)
    print("SWAP test counts (test by indicator):", swap.counts.tolist())
    print("Actual SWAP test shots:", int(swap.counts.sum()))
    print("Sampled indicator-conditioned overlap:", swap.root_overlap)
    print("Indicator-one/phase-zero probability:", solution.probability)
    print("Statevector solution fidelity:", solution.fidelity)
    print("Signed HHL real solution:", solution.statevector.real.tolist())
    print("Direct Hermitian solve:", solution.reference.real.tolist())

"""Execute fresh native HHL and the exact coherent SWAP comparison stage."""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Annotated

import torch

import flagquantum as fq
from flagquantum import synth
from flagquantum.synth import (
    Output,
    QBit,
    QNum,
    allocate,
    apply,
    inplace_prepare_amplitudes,
    qfunc,
    qpe,
    select_rotation,
    unitary,
    within,
)

from .model import COMPLEX

SHOTS = 30_000
SWAP_SEED = 3859


def build_native(
    matrix: torch.Tensor, angles: torch.Tensor, padded: torch.Tensor
) -> synth.Program:
    """Bind fresh 32-state matrix and all 64 controlled rotations."""
    evolution = tuple(tuple(map(complex, row)) for row in matrix)
    amplitudes = tuple(map(float, padded))
    rotations = tuple(map(float, angles))

    @qfunc
    def hhl(
        amplitudes: list[float],
        indicator: Output[QBit],
        time_index: Output[Annotated[QNum, 4]],
        rabbits: Output[QBit],
        rescaled_eig: Output[Annotated[QNum, (6, False, 6)]],
    ) -> None:
        allocate(time_index)
        allocate(rabbits)
        allocate(indicator)
        allocate(rescaled_eig)
        inplace_prepare_amplitudes(amplitudes, 0, (rabbits, time_index))
        with within():
            qpe(lambda: unitary(evolution, (rabbits, time_index)), rescaled_eig)
        with apply():
            select_rotation("Y", rotations, rescaled_eig, indicator)

    return synth.synthesize(
        hhl,
        classical_inputs={"amplitudes": amplitudes},
        max_workspace=4,
        max_qubits=18,
        max_operations=25_000,
        memory_limit_bytes=16 * 1024**2,
    )


def logical_state(program: synth.Program) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Expose all named HHL output amplitudes after verifying clean work bits."""
    original: torch.Tensor = fq.run(program).statevector().flatten()
    width = original.numel().bit_length() - 1
    register_order = ("indicator", "time_index", "rabbits", "rescaled_eig")
    wires = tuple(wire for name in register_order for wire in program.registers[name])
    temporary = tuple(wire for wire in range(width) if wire not in wires)
    aligned = (
        original.reshape((2,) * width).permute((*wires, *temporary)).reshape(4096, -1)
    )
    if float(aligned[:, 1:].abs().square().sum()) >= 1e-22:
        raise ValueError("Expected zero HHL workspace after inverse phase estimation")
    return aligned[:, 0].reshape(2, 32, 64)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SwapReadout:
    """Exact and finite-shot observations of test and indicator."""

    probabilities: torch.Tensor
    counts: torch.Tensor
    root_overlap: float


def sampled_swap(logical: torch.Tensor, compared: torch.Tensor) -> SwapReadout:
    """Append the normalized reference and execute the five controlled swaps."""
    normalized_reference = compared.to(COMPLEX) / compared.norm()
    test_initial = torch.tensor([1, 0], dtype=COMPLEX)
    state = torch.kron(
        torch.kron(test_initial, logical.contiguous().flatten()), normalized_reference
    )
    circuit = fq.Circuit(18, dtype=COMPLEX, inputs=state.reshape(1, -1)).h(0)
    for offset in range(5):
        circuit.cswap(0, 2 + offset, 13 + offset)
    result = circuit.h(0).state().reshape(2, 2, -1)
    probabilities: torch.Tensor = result.abs().square().sum(dim=-1)
    draws = torch.multinomial(
        probabilities.flatten(),
        SHOTS,
        replacement=True,
        generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(SWAP_SEED),
    )
    counts = torch.bincount(draws, minlength=4).reshape(2, 2)
    selected = int(counts[:, 1].sum())
    if selected == 0:
        raise ValueError("No indicator-one samples were observed")
    overlap_squared = 2 * int(counts[0, 1]) / selected - 1
    if overlap_squared < 0:
        raise ValueError("The sampled overlap estimate is below zero")
    return SwapReadout(probabilities, counts, math.sqrt(overlap_squared))

"""Regenerate the Lanchester system, Hermitian embedding and QPE eigenvalue grid."""

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass

import torch

DTYPE = torch.float64
COMPLEX = torch.complex128
N = 8
DT = 6
PHASE_WORDS = 64


def generate() -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    """Regenerate the 16-equation model and its 32-dimensional Hermitian embedding."""
    operator = torch.eye(2 * N, dtype=DTYPE)
    for step in range(1, N):
        operator[step, step - 1] = -(1 - 0.01 * DT)
        operator[step, N + step - 1] = 0.1 * DT
        operator[N + step, N + step - 1] = -(1 - 0.02 * DT)
        operator[N + step, step - 1] = -0.02 * DT
    forcing = torch.cat(
        (
            torch.full((N,), 0.4 * DT, dtype=DTYPE),
            torch.full((N,), 0.01 * DT, dtype=DTYPE),
        )
    )
    forcing[0] = 30
    forcing[N] = 1
    zero = torch.zeros_like(operator)
    hermitian = torch.cat(
        (torch.cat((zero, operator.T), dim=1), torch.cat((operator, zero), dim=1)),
        dim=0,
    )
    padded = torch.cat((torch.zeros_like(forcing), forcing / forcing.norm()))
    return operator, forcing, hermitian, padded


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Model:
    """Source system and all regenerated data required by native synthesis."""

    operator: torch.Tensor
    forcing: torch.Tensor
    hermitian: torch.Tensor
    padded: torch.Tensor
    eigenvalues: torch.Tensor
    eigenvectors: torch.Tensor
    rescaled: torch.Tensor
    phase_eigenvalues: torch.Tensor
    evolution: torch.Tensor
    angles: torch.Tensor
    cutoff: float


def build_model() -> Model:
    """Shift and rescale the spectrum for six-bit phase estimation."""
    operator, forcing, hermitian, padded = generate()
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = torch.linalg.eigh(hermitian)
    span = float(eigenvalues[-1] - eigenvalues[0])
    lower = float(eigenvalues[0])
    scale = (1 - 1 / PHASE_WORDS) / span
    rescaled = (hermitian - lower * torch.eye(4 * N, dtype=DTYPE)) * scale
    phases = (eigenvalues - lower) * scale
    vectors = eigenvectors.to(COMPLEX)
    evolution = (vectors * torch.exp(2j * math.pi * phases)) @ vectors.mH
    cutoff = span / PHASE_WORDS
    grid = torch.arange(PHASE_WORDS, dtype=DTYPE) / PHASE_WORDS
    angles = 2 * torch.asin(torch.clamp(cutoff / (grid / scale + lower), -1, 1))
    return Model(
        operator,
        forcing,
        hermitian,
        padded,
        eigenvalues,
        eigenvectors,
        rescaled,
        phases,
        evolution,
        angles,
        cutoff,
    )
"""Study the Lanchester system with fresh native HHL and a local SWAP test."""

"""Present the original system matrices, vector amplitudes, and population curves."""

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import torch

from .model import DT, N


def save_matrix_views(
    matrices: tuple[tuple[str, torch.Tensor], ...], path: Path
) -> Path:
    """Pair a matrix and its input vector where they share a model stage."""
    figure, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, len(matrices), figsize=(4.7 * len(matrices), 3.8), squeeze=False
    )
    for axis, (title, matrix) in zip(axes[0], matrices, strict=True):
        image = axis.imshow(matrix.real.numpy(), aspect="auto", cmap="coolwarm")
        axis.set(title=title, ylabel="Row")
        if matrix.shape[1] == 1:
            axis.set_xticks([])
        else:
            axis.set_xlabel("Column")
            stride = max(1, matrix.shape[1] // 8)
            axis.set_xticks(list(range(0, matrix.shape[1], stride)))
        figure.colorbar(image, ax=axis, shrink=0.8)
    figure.tight_layout()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    figure.savefig(path)
    plt.close(figure)
    return path


def save_vectors(series: tuple[tuple[str, torch.Tensor], ...], path: Path) -> Path:
    """Plot the signed components on all source basis words."""
    figure, axis = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
    for label, vector in series:
        axis.plot(range(vector.numel()), vector.real.tolist(), marker=".", label=label)
    axis.set(
        xlabel="Basis word",
        ylabel="Solution component",
        title="Lanchester solution vector",
    )
    axis.legend()
    figure.tight_layout()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    figure.savefig(path)
    plt.close(figure)
    return path


def save_populations(
    classical: torch.Tensor, path: Path, quantum: torch.Tensor | None = None
) -> Path:
    """Use the eight original times and the two source population groups."""
    figure, axis = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
    years = [DT * index for index in range(N)]
    for label, group, color in (
        ("Rabbits", slice(0, N), "tab:blue"),
        ("Foxes", slice(N, 2 * N), "tab:orange"),
    ):
        axis.plot(
            years, classical[group].real.tolist(), label=f"{label} direct", color=color
        )
        if quantum is not None:
            axis.plot(
                years,
                quantum[group].real.tolist(),
                "o--",
                label=f"{label} HHL",
                color=color,
            )
    axis.set(
        title="Predator and prey populations",
        xlabel="Time (years)",
        ylabel="Population (thousands)",
    )
    axis.legend()
    figure.tight_layout()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    figure.savefig(path)
    plt.close(figure)
    return path
